# HappyFox current model/channel registry
# Updated: 2026-08-31
# This file is intentionally concise and is NOT an exhaustive Telegram model catalog.
# Runtime model/pricing configuration and tests are the source of truth.

## Product
product_id: happyfox
repository: Bambale0/foxgen
production_branch: main
user_currency: paws (🐾)

## Channels

### Telegram
- Full HappyFox product surface: bot + Mini App.
- Model catalog is broader and runtime-driven.
- Payment providers are configuration-driven.
- CryptoBot remains available when configured.

### Instagram
- Instagram API with Instagram Login.
- Creator/Business professional account contour.
- Runtime registration requires INSTAGRAM_ENABLED=1.
- Default/example configuration keeps INSTAGRAM_ENABLED=0.
- Languages: Russian + English, auto-detected and persisted per Instagram identity.

## Instagram Photo
name: Seedream 5 Pro
product_key: seedream_5_pro
provider_model: seedream/5-pro-image-to-image
quality: high
aspect_ratio: 1:1
paid_cost_paws: 2.5
free_rule: first successful Instagram photo only
failure_rule: failed provider generation preserves free entitlement

## Instagram Video
name: Seedance 2.5
product_key: seedance_2_5
provider_model: bytedance/seedance-2-5
resolution: 720p
aspect_ratio: 9:16
price_source: shared HappyFox/Telegram Seedance pricing
free_rule: never free
entry_rule: show top-up/paywall before accepting a new reference
resume_words: Продолжить | Continue

## Instagram Payments
instagram_topup_providers:
- YooKassa
- Lava Top

lava_methods:
- card
- SBP

important: Instagram payment-provider visibility is channel-specific. Do not remove CryptoBot from Telegram.

## Instagram Meta transport
host: https://graph.instagram.com
api_version_default: v24.0
webhook_path: /instagram/webhook
subscribed_fields: messages,messaging_postbacks,comments
permissions:
- instagram_business_basic
- instagram_business_manage_messages
- instagram_business_manage_comments
- instagram_business_content_publish
security:
- GET verify token challenge
- raw-body X-Hub-Signature-256 HMAC-SHA256
- Redis event idempotency

## Durable generation
- persist job before billing/promotion side effect
- persist provider_task_id after submit
- retry same provider task after restart
- persist result_url before delivery retry
- persist delivered checkpoint after successful send
- paid terminal failure refunds once
- free-photo terminal failure releases entitlement
